summary: Audit 2026-10-05 C08-01/C07-01 close-accounting unblock on top of PR #36, with both PR review responses: unresolved/replaced orders (pre-entry included) hold an exact close only while they could still execute in the lifetime (eligible NYSE session from basis plus a 5-minute cut-off slack, until 20:00 ET plus 1 h; blocking order named in pending_close.accounting_hold_reason) and the zero-fill cleanup scan is bounded to the observed close; a broker-confirmed close fill with no or too few owner lots is persisted with attributes.lot_accounting and one post-commit CRITICAL on all five fill paths; a close applied before its opening is deferred (close-anchored 5-day window behind openings persisted-order recovery can settle, 45-day cap, one CRITICAL after 6.5 h of deferral) or netted when the opening lot lands; concurrent ingestion of an opening and its close is serialized by row locks (the netting locks every close row of its window; order rows FOR NO KEY UPDATE, close FIFO FOR UPDATE OF position_lots); documented limits: submission-time order within 5 days and out-of-order round trips across lifetimes (manual UI/API orders only); runtime snapshot blocks close_accounting_holds and fill_lot_accounting; policy id unchanged; no frozen-surface change
